svg.title: GRZ_Research · live BTC-USD limit order book
svg.desc: Live COINBASE level-2 order book for BTC-USD as two piles of particles under the cumulative depth curves, on a fixed price axis; mid 80,161.46 USD, bid wall 79,822.54 and ask wall 80,458.46. The mid replays the last 60 minutes: liquidity below it is bid, above it ask.
